findings.text: The company was incorporated on 12 August 2024 and is recorded as active with a proposal to be struck off.
The accounts are overdue, with the next accounts due on 12 May 2026 and no last made-up date recorded.
The confirmation statement is overdue; it was last made up to 11 August 2025 and the next one is due 25 August 2026.
There is one current officer, a director, PERSON 249, appointed on 13 August 2024.
One current person with significant control is recorded: PERSON 251, an individual holding 75 to 100 percent of shares.
No charges are registered against the company, and Companies House holds no insolvency record for it.
The director has no other appointments on record, and no other companies were found across the current directors checked.
No registered office address changes or officer appointments or resignations have been filed since 24 October 2025.

headline.text: TEST COMPANY 294 is active but has a proposal to be struck off the register, with overdue accounts and an overdue confirmation statement.
